votes.motion: A motion was made by Zach Robinson, seconded by Cyndi Sharkey, to approve the Consent Calendar

A motion was made by Zach Robinson, seconded by Aaron Dekeyzer to adopt Resolution 24-16C, a resolution adopting tentative budgets for Sandy City and Alta Canyon Recreation District for Fiscal Year 2024-25; scheduling a public hearing; and providing for public access to tentative budgets and schedules

A motion was made by Cyndi Sharkey, seconded by Brooke D'Sousa, to adopt Resolution 24-14C, a resolution of the Metropolitan Water District of Salt Lake and Sandy (MWDSLS) to increase its property tax for FY 2025
A motion was made by Zach Robinson, seconded by Alison Stroud to adjourn the City Council meeting and convene a meeting of the RDA Board
